{"subject":"Recap: meter data load demo","body":"Hi Hugo,

Thanks for joining today. Kofi loaded the meter readings file you sent and partitioned it by region. It took about 4 minutes. He also showed a daily usage view by region.

Kofi will send you the load summary so you have it. No send date was given on the call; we will tell you when it is sent.

You mentioned that you set up access and are not the one who decides, and that operations is probably the right group. Would you be able to tell us who in operations owns meter data loads? If it helps, the load summary is written so you can forward it to them.

Thanks again,
Mia","customer_value_line":"not stated","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U004","excerpt":"So this is the meter readings file you sent, loaded and partitioned by region. It took about 4 minutes."},{"utterance_id":"U006","excerpt":"And here's a daily usage view by region."},{"utterance_id":"U012","excerpt":"I'll send the load summary so you have it."},{"utterance_id":"U009","excerpt":"I'm not really the one who decides. I just set up access."},{"utterance_id":"U011","excerpt":"Probably operations. I'm not sure who."}]}
